claims.claim: Bounded whole-source scanning selects the final closed pytest summary. Long-tail and greater-than-65536-character final-section cases retain the same redacted identities as short equivalents.
Command summaries retain both stdout and stderr from one execution, preserving protected raw framing, command/RUN/subject provenance and exact summary digests without adding command executions.

Projection preserves identity order, caps nodes at 32 and reports truncation. Text supplies no verified count, completeness, instability, execution phase or PASS facts; absent identities remain distinct from observed zero failures.

Later unclosed, malformed or unsupported summary headers invalidate earlier spoof identities. Fixed statuses distinguish unavailable sources and scan exhaustion; oversized in-memory input receives an explicit exhaustion blocker without enlarging existing limits.

Public FAILURE, Brain Sync and terminal-attention contexts retain redacted allowlisted identities, fixed diagnostic values and source/owner bindings. Modified projections fail exact matching, and moved canonical sources fail closed.

Historical safe-detail V1 matching and public V1/V2/private FAILURE decoding remain compatible. Focused regressions cover the changed surfaces, and version 2 uses the ordinary production projection path without a separate activation gate.
